item.title: reports: fail on unrecognised CSV header
item.brief: Follow-up to the multi-currency change on this branch. Currently an unrecognised header such as "Currency" silently takes the old three-column USD path, which hides bad input. Change reports.py so only the two accepted headers are read: date,account,amount_cents (old, counts as USD) and date,account,amount_cents,currency (new). Any other header prints an error to stderr and exits 2. Add tests for the unrecognised-header case. Keep all existing tests passing (python3 -m unittest) and the README accurate. Commit on this branch only; do not push.

item.title: ledger: reject whitespace around currency code
item.brief: Follow-up to the multi-currency change on this branch. The contract says a present currency field must be exactly three uppercase ASCII letters A-Z, but the currency field is currently trimmed like the other columns, so " EUR " is accepted. Change ledger so a currency field with any surrounding whitespace, or any other non-[A-Z]{3} content, is malformed: print "line N: ..." to stderr and exit 2. Add tests for leading and trailing whitespace. Keep all existing tests passing (cargo test) and the README accurate. Commit on this branch only; do not push.

item.title: ledger: currency column in TSV input and CSV output
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated): "Our books now hold more than one currency. Two repositories need to change together. ledger (Rust) converts a TSV of transactions on stdin into CSV on stdout. Input lines may now carry a fourth column, the ISO 4217 currency code (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, e.g. EUR); when it is missing the currency is USD. The CSV header becomes date,account,amount_cents,currency and every row gets the currency. A malformed currency code must make ledger print an error naming the line number to stderr and exit with status 2 (other input errors keep exiting with status 1). Keep the existing tests passing (cargo test), update the README, and commit." Follow the shared contract exactly. Add tests for: missing currency defaults to USD; valid explicit currency; malformed currency (lowercase, wrong length, digits, empty) exits 2 with line number in stderr; other input errors still exit 1. Commit in this repo only; do not push.
